# Nexus Forge

> Open source workspace that combines data analytics, machine learning, AI document Q&A and cybersecurity tools. Built by Nikhil Chary Sriramoju, a final-year B.Tech Computer Science student in Telangana, India.

Nexus Forge is a static site with serverless functions on Vercel. Every tool also runs in the browser.

## Pages
- [Workspace](https://nexus-forge-frontend.vercel.app/workspace/): CSV analytics, regression, clustering, classification, anomaly detection and document Q&A
- [Security lab](https://nexus-forge-frontend.vercel.app/security/): AES-256-GCM encrypted notes, SHA-256 file fingerprints and log analysis
- [Projects](https://nexus-forge-frontend.vercel.app/projects/): selected machine learning and data engineering projects
- [Architecture](https://nexus-forge-frontend.vercel.app/architecture/): technology stack and how the parts connect
- [Credentials](https://nexus-forge-frontend.vercel.app/about/): education, internships and certifications
- [FAQ](https://nexus-forge-frontend.vercel.app/faq/): hosting and configuration questions

## Source
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Nikhil-creat/nexus-forge): code, tests and deployment files
